root_cause.text: In `drivers/gpio/gpio-loongson-64bit.c`, `loongson_gpio_init_irqchip()` allocated `chip->irq.parents` with `devm_kcalloc()` but mistakenly checked `chip->parent` for NULL, so allocation failure for the IRQ parent array was not detected and could lead to invalid use of a NULL pointer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `if (!chip->parent)` to `if (!chip->irq.parents)` immediately after `chip->irq.parents = devm_kcalloc(...)`, and the commit message explicitly says the function “checks chip->parent instead of chip->irq.parents.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix the irq parent allocation error check to properly handle allocation failure in loongson GPIO irqchip initialization.
intent_record.what: In loongson_gpio_init_irqchip(), the NULL check after allocating chip->irq.parents was changed from `if (!chip->parent)` to `if (!chip->irq.parents)`.
intent_record.how: This fixes the allocation failure check so the function now correctly detects when the newly allocated parent IRQ array is unavailable and returns -ENOMEM instead of incorrectly testing an unrelated member.
